第一次来，可以先做这两件事: New here? Start with two small things
保存常用校方入口，再提前看看第一堂课的建筑位置与入口。: Keep the university links handy, then check the building and entrance for your first class.
常用校方服务，一次收好。点击后打开对应官方网站。: Keep university services close. Each link opens its official website.
本 App 浏览无需登录；部分校方服务会在官网要求使用校方账号登录。: Browsing this app needs no account. Some university services require university sign-in on their own websites.
核对自己的入学安排: Check the arrangements for your programme
把注册、迎新、学生证与课程相关通知集中保存。不同课程和学生类别的安排可能不同，按: Keep registration, orientation, student-card and course notices together. Check the instructions sent for your own programme and student category.
将校方门户与课程平台加入浏览器书签。第一次使用前，先确认账户、邮箱和校园网络能正: Bookmark the university portal and course platform. Check that your account, email and campus network access work before you need them.
第一次上课，先找楼再找入口: Find the building, then the entrance
把课表上的建筑名称与地图对照，提前看入口照片和楼层说明。给第一次找课室留出一点时: Match the building name on your timetable to the map. Check entrance photos and floor guidance, and allow time to find an unfamiliar classroom.
出发前查一眼开放安排: Check opening arrangements before setting off
去图书馆、餐饮点或服务柜台前，查看对应官网的最新开放安排，减少白跑一趟。: Check the relevant official website before visiting a library, dining outlet or service counter.
把 CEDARS、学院与校园 IT 帮助入口放在常用链接里。遇到学习生活或账户网: Keep CEDARS, faculty and IT support links handy so you can find the appropriate service when needed.
把第一周过得从容一点。下面是通用小建议，具体入学安排以校方通知为准。: A few practical ideas for settling in. Follow your university notices for programme-specific arrangements.
先看下一堂课在哪栋楼，再决定去哪吃。: Check your next classroom before picking a lunch spot.

下课后的咖啡与轻食: Coffee and a small bite after class

周末聚餐，先说清怎么集合: Weekend meals: make meeting up easy

一起探索步行路线、分享沿途风景，也可以约同学从校园出发认识周边。正式群介绍可补充: Explore walking routes, share scenery and discover the neighbourhood together. A real group can add route difficulty and meeting arrangements.

交流喜欢的桌游和电影，寻找愿意一起参加线下休闲活动的同学。正式发布时可补充活动形: Talk about games and films and meet others interested in casual activities. A real listing can describe the activities and joining process.
